subject: GrowthLane: conditional credits & onboarding milestones
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@growthlane.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@growthlane.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Quick request — starter credits + demo milestones

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers looked promising and the team loves the streaming API. We're trying to accelerate a short pilot tied to our Q1 product launch and were hoping Redwood could approve a small starter grant to cover inference spend for the first 90 days. Key items:

- Pilot scope: 3 models (chat + rerank + embeddings), ~25k tokens/day average, v1 privacy requirements listed in the attached deck.
- Asks: $5k in credits + a 30-day trial extension to run steady-state load testing.
- Milestones: 1) onboarding + test harness (week 1–2), 2) perf validation (week 3), 3) go/no-go decision (end of month).

I've attached a short intro deck and a procurement contact on CC. Happy to jump on a quick alignment call if that helps.

Best,
Emily Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
GrowthLane

[Attachment: GrowthLane_IntroDeck.pdf (pptx)]

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask and the deck. Looks like a good fit for our Startup Onramp program. Quick notes:

- We can provision a conditional $5k credit package that vests across the milestone windows you outlined.
- Trial extension: we can open a 30-day extension, but to protect unit economics we request an onboarding checklist and a basic test harness to capture token distribution (can use our sample harness).
- Legal/procurement: I'll loop in Laura and Jordan to confirm contract terms and any SSO/KMS needs.

Next step: can you confirm which model family you'll be using (open-llama-70b / redwood-chat-13b / other) and whether logs need to be forwarded to your SIEM? If you can send a signed one-page term sheet we'll kick off internal approvals.

Thanks — sending a short term sheet now.

Best,

Subject: GrowthLane onboarding credit package — next steps & term sheet

Hi Emily — following internal review, happy to confirm the conditional starter package. Summary below and next steps:

- Credit package: $5,000 in service credits, released in three tranches: $1,500 on onboarding completion, $1,750 after perf validation, $1,750 on final go decision.
- Trial extension: 30 days from the date of activation.
- Requirements: signed one-page term sheet (attached), delivery of test harness report (sample template provided), basic SSO with OIDC (optional KMS integration flagged for legal).
- Timeline: aim to activate credits within 48 hours of receiving the signed term sheet.
- Escalation: if procurement requests contract redlines, please route to contracts@redwood.com with subject GL-2026-091; we can fast-track review within 48 business hours.

I've attached the one-page term sheet and included a DocuSign link for convenience: https://docusign.net/embeddedSigning/abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/GL-2026-091

If that all looks good I can activate the extension and credit hold once we have the signed sheet. Happy to hop on a call tomorrow morning if you want to walk the milestones.

Thanks — excited to get GrowthLane running on Redwood.
